disease_master.name: Newcastle disease
disease_master.signs: Greenish diarrhoea, twisted neck, gasping, sudden drop in egg production
disease_master.actions: Isolate shed, stop movement, call vet, revaccinate healthy birds, disinfect

disease_master.name: Gumboro (Infectious bursal disease)
disease_master.signs: Ruffled feathers, whitish diarrhoea, vent pecking, 3-6 week chicks
disease_master.actions: Electrolytes + vitamins in water, reduce protein 2 days, call vet

disease_master.name: Coccidiosis
disease_master.signs: Bloody droppings, huddling, pale comb, poor growth
disease_master.actions: Anticoccidial in water (amprolium/toltrazuril), dry litter, call vet

disease_master.name: Chronic respiratory disease (Mycoplasma)
disease_master.signs: Sneezing, nasal discharge, swollen face, rales
disease_master.actions: Improve ventilation, tylosin/tiamulin as prescribed, check ammonia

disease_master.name: Colibacillosis (E. coli)
disease_master.signs: Omphalitis in chicks, airsacculitis, pericarditis on post-mortem
disease_master.actions: Water sanitation, antibiotic as per sensitivity, brooding hygiene

disease_master.name: Heat stress
disease_master.signs: Panting, wings spread, drop in feed intake, mortality in afternoons
disease_master.actions: Cool water with electrolytes, foggers, reduce stocking, feed at night

disease_master.name: Fowl pox
disease_master.signs: Scabs on comb/wattle, diphtheritic lesions in mouth
disease_master.actions: Vaccinate contact birds, iodine on lesions, mosquito control

disease_master.name: Marek’s disease
disease_master.signs: Leg paralysis (one forward one back), grey eye, tumours
disease_master.actions: Cull affected, check vaccination at hatchery, biosecurity
